relations.rationale: Teams guiding robots through a course sets up the scenario where robots clear checkpoints and spectators react.
Multiple teams guiding robots through a course is consistent with some robots being faster than others, but doesn't establish it directly.
The fact that teams guided robots through a course has no bearing on relative ages of participants.
Guiding robots through a course doesn't relate to the color of Noor's robot.
The course-guiding activity doesn't bear on whether Noor's robot was easy to spot.
Nell finishing ahead of Ivo doesn't determine the relative finish of Ivo and Kira.
Nell's finishing position relative to Ivo has no bearing on Kira's hopes for improvement.
Nell finishing ahead of Ivo doesn't directly determine whether Kira finished ahead of Nell.
Finishing position in a robot race has no logical connection to relative ages.
Nell's finish relative to Ivo doesn't inform whether Kira's and Ivo's designs performed equally in trials.
Spectators clapping at checkpoints doesn't establish relative speeds of robots.
Spectators clapping has no bearing on who is the oldest participant.
Spectators clapping during the event is a small consistent detail with the general end-of-day gathering, but doesn't specifically support or contradict it.
Relative robot speeds have no connection to participant ages.
Noor watching timers closely directly supports the idea that she noted completions with careful attention.
Noor watching timers has no bearing on Leo helping newer members solder wires.
Noor's careful attention to completions doesn't bear on Kira's hopes for improving her robot.
Noor noting completions carefully has no bearing on the design complexity of Kira's or Ivo's robots.
Ivo finishing ahead of Kira doesn't explain or relate to Kira adjusting her robot's wheels after a collision.

If Ivo finished ahead of Kira, then Kira could not have finished ahead of Nell if that would require her also beating Ivo\u2014but since these are different comparisons, they aren't logically exclusive; however, combined with typical transitive race context, Ivo>Kira and Kira>Nell are compatible, not contradictory.
